subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related merged fixes preserved that behavior, and a broad default change would affect multiple user-visible surfaces, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Change agent-visible and tool-display paths to full absolute paths by default, then update shared helpers, prompts, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Add Explicit Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep existing defaults but add a documented opt-in setting for users who need absolute path output, with tests for both modes.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans shared display helpers and user-visible agent surfaces, and recent file history points to this account as the strongest routing candidate for product/display-contract review.
